This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue describes a pagination bug with reports appearing on multiple pages or missing. The maintainer has identified this as a bug fixed in version 3.2.1 by PR #901, ordering reports by id to avoid overlap. The reporter confirmed upgrading to 3.2.1 fixed the problem. The issue is resolved with no code changes currently required for this repository version.
